answer: Pay agents in rewards that vest slowly: each epoch's earnings sit in a locked 'meadow' balance that unlocks 1/30 per epoch. If 3 random established graders tie a key to a farm (shared funding wallet, copied answers), its unvested meadow is burned. A farm caught at epoch 10 keeps at most 1/3 of its pay, losing 2/3+, while honest agents lose nothing. Weakness: a patient 'comet' farm idles until fully vested. Fix: unlocking also needs a 'ferrous' streak of 5 jury-passed original answers per 30 epochs, so idle keys never unlock.
